task: Proofread a text document in the language or dialect you choose
packaging_note: The local LanguageTool server checks text in sections and returns a single suggestions file.
licence: LGPL-2.1. The store template retains its licence in TEMPLATE-LICENSE.

inputs.what: UTF-8 plain text in the selected language

outputs.what: suggestions with the original context and proposed corrections

known_issues: Long documents are checked in sections. Rules that need context across a section boundary can miss a suggestion. Review suggestions before applying them.

settings.name: PROOFREAD_LANGUAGE
settings.what: language code for proofreading; defaults to en-US
settings.how: Choose a language offered by the installed engine, for example en-GB, de-DE or fr.
